title: Sasuke Rinnegan Chase Funko Pop Naruto Glow in Dark Special Limited Edition
descriptionText: The product is a special limited edition Sasuke Rinnegan Chase Funko Pop from the Naruto franchise. This vinyl figure features a glow in the dark effect and comes with a protector. It is an exclusive item from Funko and is part of the Pop product line, perfect for fans of anime and manga.
